Title: Cyrena.Dotnet - SolutionParser
Summary: Parses .sln and .slnx files to extract project file paths and details.
Content:
## SolutionParser

**Namespace:** `Cyrena.Dotnet.Options`
**Assembly:** `Cyrena.Dotnet`

### Purpose
Parses .sln and .slnx files to extract project file paths.

### Static Methods

```csharp
public static List<string> GetProjectPaths(string solutionFilePath);
public static List<ProjectInfo> GetProjectDetails(string solutionFilePath);
```

### Supported Formats

| Extension | Format | Parser |
|-----------|--------|--------|
| `.sln` | Traditional text | `ParseSlnFile` — regex on `Project("{GUID}") = "Name", "Path", "{GUID}"` |
| `.slnx` | XML (VS 2022+) | `ParseSlnxFile` — `XDocument` on `Project Path="..."` elements |

### ProjectInfo

```csharp
public class ProjectInfo
{
    public string AbsolutePath { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string FileName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string ProjectName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string ProjectType { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public bool Exists { get; set; }
}
```

### Supported Project Extensions
`.csproj`, `.vbproj`, `.fsproj`, `.vcxproj`, `.sqlproj`, `.sfproj`, `.wapproj`, `.pyproj`, `.njsproj`, `.shproj`, `.esproj`

### Behavior
- Converts relative paths to absolute paths
- Skips solution folders (`.sln` extension in path)
- Returns `Exists` flag indicating if project file exists
